title: AI Cold Chain Risk Predictor
short: Predicts temperature excursions in storage and transport from logger, route and weather data — before vaccines and biologics are exposed.
symptom: Temperature excursions are discovered after delivery
ingredient: An excursion early-warning for the cold chain
directions: Connect data loggers and shipment plans. Get excursion-risk scores per shipment and live alerts while products are in transit.
problem: Temperature data from loggers is usually reviewed after the shipment arrives; excursions are discovered too late to prevent product loss.
why: Excursions can destroy vaccines, insulin and biologics worth large amounts and interrupt patient supply.
solution: Learns which routes, packaging, seasons and handover points lead to excursions, scores each planned shipment and monitors live logger data to alert before limits are exceeded.
data: Shipment routes, packaging and handover times
Weather data and product stability limits
limitations: Prediction does not replace validated monitoring and alarms
Product disposition depends on approved stability data
review: Quality assurance decides on the disposition of any exposed product.
